standard.title: AisleLens Coffee Standard v1.3 — buyer questions, assertions and evidence rules for roasted coffee product pages

result.task: Find the Miraflores | Pink Bourbon, confirm it's single-origin, organic, purchasable one-time with fast US shipping.

assertions.label: Whole bean option is listed and purchasable
assertions.detail: A "Whole Bean" variant is listed and purchasable.

assertions.label: Ground option is listed and purchasable
assertions.detail: Checked the public variant list — no "Ground" variant found.

assertions.label: Espresso grind option is listed and purchasable
assertions.detail: A "Espresso" variant is listed and purchasable.

assertions.label: Filter grind option is listed and purchasable
assertions.detail: A "Filter" variant is listed and purchasable.

assertions.label: A weight or measurement is stated in readable text
assertions.detail: Stated in your variant options, in a specification block rather than a sentence we can quote.

assertions.label: An organic claim is stated in readable text
assertions.detail: Checked product copy, structured data, product title, variant options and page description — no statement an AI buyer could verify.

assertions.label: A fair-trade scheme claim is stated in readable text
assertions.detail: Checked product copy, structured data, product title, variant options and page description — no statement an AI buyer could verify.

assertions.label: A single-origin claim is stated in readable text
assertions.detail: Checked product copy, structured data, product title, variant options and page description — no statement an AI buyer could verify.

assertions.label: A product identifier is published in structured data
assertions.detail: Your product structured data publishes no GTIN or MPN, so a machine buyer can't match this product to a catalogue entry.

assertions.label: A dispatch or delivery window is stated
assertions.detail: No delivery timing in your public product data, and your shipping policy page couldn't be read publicly.

suggestedCorrections: Make the "Ground option is listed and purchasable" option visible and purchasable in your public variant list.
Confirm whether this product is an organic claim is stated in readable text. If it is, state it in a product field and in customer-readable copy so an AI buyer can verify it.
Confirm whether this product is a fair-trade scheme claim is stated in readable text. If it is, state it in a product field and in customer-readable copy so an AI buyer can verify it.
Confirm whether this product is a single-origin claim is stated in readable text. If it is, state it in a product field and in customer-readable copy so an AI buyer can verify it.
State a product identifier is published in structured data in a form an AI buyer can verify.
result.suggestedCorrection: Make the "Ground option is listed and purchasable" option visible and purchasable in your public variant list.
